recovered_lane.scope: Recovered single-reasoning-step classifier; historical task performance and steering remain blocked until faithful source replay is established.

new_toy_lane.label: New synthetic recurrent workflow gate; independent of historical task claims

data.rule: veto if x3 + 0.5*x4 > 0.35; else commit if x0 + 0.5*x1 - 0.25*x2 > 0.1; else repair

intervention.selection: minimum target-veto calibration cross_entropy; then candidate index then negative sign for ties
intervention.random_distribution: outer product of independent standard Gaussian vectors, normalized to the same Frobenius dose
intervention.gradient_baseline: negative rank-one SVD approximation to target-veto cross-entropy gradient on training rows, normalized to the same dose

endpoints.primary: mean over seeds of (random target-veto NLL minus VPD target-veto NLL)
endpoints.per_seed_uncertainty: paired target-row bootstrap, 2000 resamples, percentile 95% interval
endpoints.across_seed_uncertainty: Student t 95% interval on three independent seed effects, df=2
endpoints.positive_rule: all prerequisite gates pass; all three primary seed effects positive; across-seed lower 95% bound above zero; VPD collateral accuracy drop <=0.02 in every seed
endpoints.replication_unit: independently trained model/decomposition/selection seed, with an independently generated heldout set
endpoints.multiplicity: one primary endpoint and one dose; secondary endpoints are descriptive
